integrity: Proof given with exact exponential reduction, strict concavity, beta integral and elementary extremal-value limit. Standalone numerical cross-checks supplied; they are not proof or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized Euclidean volume, nondegenerate simplices, strictly interior centers and logarithmic cross-ratio normalization. Not a Busemann/Holmes–Thompson volume theorem. Gumbel threshold is centroid-anchored and asymptotic; the statement does not cover arbitrary convex domains. Historical priority is subject to independent review.
title: Sharp centroid optimality and a Gumbel volume threshold for Hilbert balls in simplices
